# agentmail v0.1.0 - Table of Contents

Elixir client for the AgentMail API

## Pages

- [Agentmail](https://agentmail.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Agentmail](https://agentmail.hexdocs.pm/Agentmail.md): Elixir client for the [AgentMail API](https://docs.agentmail.to/api-reference).
- [Agentmail.Domains](https://agentmail.hexdocs.pm/Agentmail.Domains.md): Manage custom domains for sending email.
- [Agentmail.Inboxes](https://agentmail.hexdocs.pm/Agentmail.Inboxes.md): Manage AgentMail inboxes.
- [Agentmail.Messages](https://agentmail.hexdocs.pm/Agentmail.Messages.md): Send, receive, and manage emails within an inbox.
- [Agentmail.Threads](https://agentmail.hexdocs.pm/Agentmail.Threads.md): Manage email threads within an inbox.
- [Agentmail.Webhooks](https://agentmail.hexdocs.pm/Agentmail.Webhooks.md): Manage webhooks for receiving email events.

- Exceptions
  - [Agentmail.Error](https://agentmail.hexdocs.pm/Agentmail.Error.md): Represents an error response from the AgentMail API.
